title: Shrine Law Under Teeth: War Memory
description: Shrine Law Under Teeth unfolds across inner shrine court where spirit contracts become tactical boundaries, pushing a one active Kami Titan to prove precise control, repositioning, evasion, spirit terrain, disciplined burst. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Shrine Law Under Teeth: War Memory advances Kami Mirror Tempest: The Sacred Kingdoms test whether the Creator can cleanse Gate reflections without breaking shrine law or spirit contracts. It directly tests the faction tension: Their secrecy protects sacred balance but makes allies fear what they cannot see.
